name: La Almolda (Spain)
description: Blue field with a pale of the bars of Aragon towards the hoist, charged at the hoist with a yellow castle and at the fly with two white wavy stripes.
history: Municipal flag of La Almolda; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: pale of yellow and red bars towards the hoist
bars on the pale and a crescent and star on the hoist
two wavy stripes across the fly
